import Mathlib

example (p q : Prop) : p ∧ q → q ∧ p := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hp, hq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hq, hp⟩

example (p q r : Prop) (h : p → q → r) (hp : p) (hq : q) : r := by
  exact h hp hq

example (p q r : Prop) : (p → q) → (q → r) → p → r := by
  intro hpq hqr hp
  apply hqr
  apply hpq
  exact hp
